purpose: Educational on-page SEO review heuristics, not ranking guarantees.

review: Review multiple H1s in context rather than treating them as an automatic technical failure.
Review large heading-level jumps for document structure.
Remember that X-Robots-Tag HTTP headers are not visible in HTML.
Classify same-host HTTP(S) links as internal.
Do not treat mailto, tel, javascript, data, or fragment-only links as internal pages.
